#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cmath>

int main() {
    int n, b;
    std::cin >> n >> b;
    std::vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }

    std::vector<int> oddCount(n + 1, 0);
    std::vector<int> evenCount(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if ((a[i - 1] & 1) == 1) {
            oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1] + 1;
            evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1];
        } else {
            oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1];
            evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1] + 1;
        }
    }

    int startIdx = 0;
    std::priority_queue<int, std::vector<int>, std::greater<int>> diffHeap;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        int oDiff = oddCount[i] - oddCount[startIdx];
        int eDiff = evenCount[i] - evenCount[startIdx];
        if (oDiff == eDiff) {
            diffHeap.push(std::abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]));
            startIdx = i;
        }
    }

    int totalCost = 0;
    int selectedCount = 0;
    while (!diffHeap.empty() && totalCost + diffHeap.top() <= b) {
        totalCost += diffHeap.top();
        diffHeap.pop();
        ++selectedCount;
    }
    std::cout << selectedCount << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
